LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.MotorShop.WordPress
LocaleResource.Value: Shows published WordPress posts, guides and pages under /blog and /rehberler in the MOTOR storefront. Products, stock, orders and payments stay in MOTOR.

LocaleResource.Name: Blog.Intro
LocaleResource.Value: Articles on motorcycle maintenance, gear and riding.

LocaleResource.Name: Guides.Intro
LocaleResource.Value: Technical guides for maintenance, fitting and choosing the right part.

LocaleResource.Name: NoPosts
LocaleResource.Value: Nothing has been published here yet.

LocaleResource.Name: StaleNotice
LocaleResource.Value: The content cannot be updated right now; the last saved version is shown.

LocaleResource.Name: Unavailable
LocaleResource.Value: The blog is not available right now. The shop, cart and checkout work as usual.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.Instruction
LocaleResource.Value: WordPress is connected as a headless content source. For security the connection is not edited here; it comes from environment variables: MotorShop__WordPress__Enabled, MotorShop__WordPress__BaseUrl, optionally MotorShop__WordPress__UserName and MotorShop__WordPress__ApplicationPassword (a WordPress application password, not the admin password). See docs/motor/wordpress.md.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.OpenWordPressHint
LocaleResource.Value: Opens in a new tab. You sign in to WordPress with your own WordPress user; the MOTOR session is not shared.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.PerInstance
LocaleResource.Value: These values are per application instance and reset on restart.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.CacheCleared
LocaleResource.Value: Blog cache refreshed ({0} entries). The next visit loads current content from WordPress.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.SitemapInvalidated
LocaleResource.Value: The XML sitemap is rebuilt with the current posts on the next request.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.Warning.DevFlags
LocaleResource.Value: AllowInsecureHttp or AllowPrivateNetwork is on in production. They are for local development only; turn them off.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.Warning.ShortSecret
LocaleResource.Value: WebhookSecret must have at least {0} characters; the webhook is off.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.Warning.NoGuideCategory
LocaleResource.Value: WordPress has no category with the slug "{0}"; /rehberler stays empty.

LocaleResource.Name: Admin.Warning.SlugCollision
LocaleResource.Value: The URL "{0}" belongs to a {1} record (#{2}) and collides with the blog URL. Change the SEO name of that record.
